baseline_models.focus_anchor: The restrictive opening, the singular wali predicate, and its coordination of God, the Messenger, and those who believe.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus inventories combine immediate nearness, active care, and support in wali. The coordinated referents therefore form a differentiated relational field: divine source, message-bearing envoy, and believing participants who make that relation locally operative.

activation_trace.role: Uninterrupted adjacency supplies the wali relation with immediacy rather than distant sympathy.
Taking charge of an affair makes the relation operational care rather than a bare feeling.
Love and active support supply the solidaristic force that joins the coordinated referents.
A message and its bearer make the Messenger the transmissive node of the relation.
Settled assent identifies the believing participants by entrusted response rather than ancestry.

changed_reading.before: The verse names a flat list of allies or protectors.
changed_reading.after: The verse restricts wilaya to a layered field in which source, transmission, and communal enactment are distinct but contiguous functions.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated relative construction describing believers as those who establish prayer and give zakat.
baseline_models.mechanism: Belief is immediately expanded into maintained worship and outward transfer. Establishing prayer keeps a shared order standing, while giving zakat moves purifying and growth-bearing value outward; the believing term in the wali series is thus an observable practice profile.

activation_trace.role: Sustained care and guardianship make establishing prayer a maintained communal responsibility.
The specified worship supplies the recurring form whose integrity is maintained.
Concrete giving turns affiliation into an outward transfer rather than a verbal claim.
Increase and growth make the transfer productive for the relation rather than merely subtractive for the giver.
Purification makes material transfer an ethical test of the community's condition.

changed_reading.before: Those who believe is a sufficient static group label.
changed_reading.after: The believing member of the wali relation is recognizable by maintained worship and purifying material care.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The movement from establishing prayer to giving while in a bowed or humbled posture.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus holds upright establishment and bodily lowering together. Capacity to stand an order up is checked by the willingness to bend, and giving occurs inside that lowered posture; authority and support are therefore disciplined by humility.

activation_trace.role: Bodily standing supplies the upright pole of the focus verse's vertical movement.
Bending and lowering the head supplies the answering downward pole.
Voluntary humility turns bodily lowering into the ethical regulator of standing capacity.
Giving locates material agency within, not outside, the humbled posture.

changed_reading.before: Prayer, almsgiving, and bowing are three adjacent pious traits.
changed_reading.after: They form one embodied mechanism: stand the practice up, move value outward, and keep that capacity bowed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening pericope first tests an offered approach by acceptance and guardedness, then opposes a hand extended to kill with refusal to extend a retaliatory hand, and finally scales preserving one life to preserving all people. In that sequence, giving zakat while lowered redirects agency from seizure and injury toward an accepted, life-serving transfer. Wilaya becomes enacted nonpredation as well as support.

activation_trace.role: The focus verse's act of giving supplies the outward action whose direction the hand sequence revises.
Purification marks the transferred value as ethically unlike predatory acquisition.
An offering used to draw near supplies the presented-transfer frame that precedes the focus gift.
Reception with approval makes acceptance, not mere delivery, the discriminant of an offering.
Placing oneself within protection supplies the guarded moral posture linked to acceptance.
Literal extension and release of the hand marks agency moving toward another, here exposed as lethal reach.
The bodily hand localizes the contrast between harmful extension and the focus verse's beneficent transfer.
Keeping alive rather than killing gives outgoing agency its life-preserving social horizon.

structural_cues: 5:27 moves from two offerings through unequal acceptance to a threatened killing.
5:28 contrasts two explicitly extended hands, and 5:32 universalizes killing and preserving life.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies offering, acceptance, guardedness, opposed hands, and life preservation; I infer that their directional contrast reclassifies the focus gift as the hand-sign of viable wilaya. A live alternative is that this sequence remains a general ethical frame and does not specifically qualify zakat.

changed_reading.before: Giving zakat is one conventional devotional qualification of the believing group.
changed_reading.after: Giving while lowered is the lifeward redirection of the hand that makes communal support acceptable rather than predatory.

context_deltas.mechanism: The legal-scriptural pericope contrasts words displaced from their positions with people entrusted to guard, witness, and oversee revelation. This activates the focus sequence as a custody chain: the Messenger bears what is sent, while believers maintain its enacted form through prayer and transfer. Wali thus includes responsibility for keeping a trust in place.

activation_trace.role: Taking charge supplies the focus relation with custodial responsibility.
The carried message and its bearer provide the trust that must pass through the chain.
Ongoing care and preservation make establishing prayer the enacted maintenance of that trust.
Deviation from a direction supplies the failure mode: transmitted words are bent away from their course.
Putting something in a settled position makes displacement from proper locations a spatial model of distortion.
Watchful guarding supplies the positive custodial task opposed to displacement.
Present witnessing makes custody publicly answerable rather than privately possessed.
Witnessing joined to oversight supplies the governing model for faithful transmission.

structural_cues: 5:41 describes oral profession without heart-faith and words shifted after their positions.
5:44 assigns guarding and witnessing of the Book, while 5:48 describes the new Book as confirming and overseeing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distortion as displacement and faithful transmission as guarding, witnessing, and oversight; I infer that the focus triad names a custody chain whose communal link is verified by maintained practice. A live alternative is that these are parallel descriptions of legal authority rather than a mechanism internal to wali.

changed_reading.before: The Messenger and believers are adjacent objects of loyalty.
changed_reading.after: They are successive custodial functions: message-bearing and embodied maintenance keep the divine trust from being displaced.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet assigns communities distinct access routes and clear paths, explicitly withholds forced singularity, and redirects plurality into a race toward goods. The focus verse then reads less like a bare inherited bloc and more like a practice-formed cohort: its members are identified by what they continuously maintain and give within the shared return to God.

activation_trace.role: Maintained care turns community identity into an ongoing task.
Giving makes the task externally observable in material action.
Growth makes the observable practice productive rather than merely boundary-marking.
An exposed place of water access gives each assigned norm a concrete point of entry to provision.
A plainly marked road supplies the distinct but navigable course assigned to a community.
A community or kind supplies the collective unit that could have been made singular.
Union into one direction supplies the explicitly unrealized alternative to assigned plurality.
Competitive forward movement converts differing paths into urgency toward action.
Movement toward what benefits supplies the race's shared practical destination.

structural_cues: 5:48 juxtaposes a distinct shir'a and minhaj for each with the unrealized possibility of one community.
The same ayah says plurality tests what each has received, commands racing toward goods, and gathers everyone in return to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assigned plurality, testing, a race toward goods, and common return; I infer that the focus relative clauses operationalize the tested path by naming repeatable practices. A live alternative is that the focus still designates a bounded community whose identity is not being redefined by 5:48.

changed_reading.before: Those who believe is primarily a fixed confessional bloc.
changed_reading.after: The focus profiles a cohort formed and tested through maintained worship and beneficial transfer while plural paths remain visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The middle pericope gives corrupt authority an intake economy: consuming illicit gain and exchanging signs for a small price. The focus reverses the flow through giving and purification, while the adjacent replacement people receive divine bounty. Material direction therefore audits affiliation: exploitative intake and sale deform custody, whereas outgoing zakat enacts support.

activation_trace.role: Active support makes material conduct relevant to the quality of affiliation.
Giving fixes the focus economy's direction as outward.
Purification makes the direction of wealth an ethical diagnostic.
Consuming and absorbing wealth supplies the opposing inward flow.
Defective illicit gain qualifies that inward flow as corrupt sustenance.
Commercial exchange makes entrusted signs vulnerable to conversion into private return.
Sale value supplies the measurable private consideration received for that conversion.
Smallness exposes the disproportion between the trust surrendered and the return obtained.
Unbought beneficence supplies the source from which the replacement community can give rather than sell.

structural_cues: 5:42 pairs avid reception of lies with consumption of illicit gain.
5:44 forbids selling signs for a small price; 5:54 names the replacement people's condition as divine bounty immediately before focus giving.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed economic verbs and valuations; I infer that the direction of material flow distinguishes exploitative patronage from focus-verse wilaya. A live alternative is that judicial corruption and zakat are separate concerns whose proximity does not establish an allegiance economy.

changed_reading.before: Zakat is a charitable trait appended to a statement about allies.
changed_reading.after: Zakat materially audits wilaya: the trustworthy network channels value outward instead of consuming illicit gain or selling its trust.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding replacement portrait combines mutual love, gentleness toward believers, strength toward rejecters, and costly exertion. It therefore disambiguates the focus's upright-and-bowed posture: bowing is God-directed humility and inward social tenderness, not incapacity, while standing the practice up includes resilience under external pressure.

activation_trace.role: Standing supplies disciplined capacity rather than domination.
Chosen humility supplies the lowered pole without implying helplessness.
Love and mutual support make the posture relational rather than merely individual.
Love held in the heart supplies the mutual bond from which the social posture proceeds.
Gentleness without humiliation specifies the lowered posture toward believing peers.
Strength after lowliness supplies the contrasting firmness toward hostile pressure.
Expenditure of capacity under difficulty shows that gentleness coexists with strenuous action.

structural_cues: 5:54 places mutual love, gentleness toward believers, strength toward rejecters, exertion, and freedom from blame-fear in one portrait.
5:55 follows with standing prayer and bowing, preserving the same polarity in embodied worship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit relational polarity and the focus supplies upright and lowered bodily cues; I infer that the two calibrate one posture across different relations. A live alternative is that raki'un only names a ritual state and should not inherit the social polarity of 5:54.

changed_reading.before: Bowing characterizes the wali community as generally meek.
changed_reading.after: Its humility is selective and disciplined: lowered before God and gentle within the believing relation, yet firm under coercive pressure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing pericope contrasts reciprocal outside affiliations and fear-driven rushing with the focus triad, then repeats that exact triad as the object of active taking-wilaya. The feared reversal exposes opportunistic affiliation as a sickness; collapsed deeds show its failure, while the party and prevailing language make strength an outcome of stable alignment rather than the reason for hedging into it.

activation_trace.role: Love and active support anchor the positive affiliation at the center of the contrast.
Reciprocal alliance and support supplies a rival affiliation that also forms social identity.
Departure from healthy balance diagnoses fear-driven affiliation as relational disorder.
A feared adverse turn or defeat supplies the volatility against which opportunists hedge.
Falling away turns loudly sworn affiliation into failed work.
Actively taking God, the Messenger, and believers in support repeats the focus triad as a chosen relation.
A group cohering around one commitment supplies the collective result of that choice.
Prevailing force supplies the outcome of alignment, reversing the prior fear of defeat.

structural_cues: 5:51 says reciprocal awliya relations make the one who takes them become of them.
5:52 explains rushing into that relation by fear of an adverse turn, and 5:53 reports the collapse of sworn works.
5:54 inserts a replacement people marked by mutual love and fearlessness; 5:56 repeats the exact 5:55 triad under an active yatawalla construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rival identity-forming affiliations, risk hedging, failed works, and an exact positive restatement; I infer that the focus nominal clause answers the hedge with noncontingent alignment evidenced before victory by repeated practices. A live alternative is that 5:51 concerns a narrower boundary rule and does not yield a general account of opportunistic wilaya.

changed_reading.before: The focus identifies the permissible allies of believers.
changed_reading.after: It identifies an identity-forming commitment that cannot be entered as insurance against changing fortunes; maintained prayer and giving are its pre-outcome evidence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the racing sense of the prayer root and split-root following images rather than the ordinary surface senses. It remains anchored in the focus sequence of wali, Messenger, prayer, and in contextual following and racing. Downstream prose should present it only as a secondary relay image, not as a lexical replacement for prayer or a syntactic claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus sequence joins succession-capable wali, a dispatched Messenger, and prayer whose branch inventory includes the second runner following the leader.

activation_trace.role: Unbroken succession supplies the relay's continuous handoff.
Dispatch and release put the message-bearing participant into motion.
The runner immediately behind the leader supplies a form-distant image of close, ordered following.
The second split inventory preserves the same trailing-runner image and prevents collapsing the root's mapped branches.
Tracking an earlier trace supplies historical continuation rather than isolated arrival.
The alternate mapped root also contributes explicit trace-following to the relay.
Allegiant succession supplies the warned-against possibility of following the wrong course.
Racing forward activates the focus prayer root's second-runner image within a shared course.
The active restatement of the focus triad extends succession from description into chosen participation.
The repeated dispatched figure keeps the relay centered on transmission.

changed_reading.before: God, Messenger, and believers are a roster of affiliation.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they form a relay of alignment: dispatch, close following, maintained handoff, and a race toward goods.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain material analogy built from remote rain, channel, watering-place, and water-opening branches. It remains multiply anchored in focus wali, giving, and zakat, with contextual life and path cues. Downstream prose should label it an ecological visualization of support and circulation, never the direct lexical sense of the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines a wali branch of following rain, an giving branch of channeling water, and zakat's growth image.

activation_trace.role: Rain arriving after the first seasonal rain supplies support as timely replenishment in sequence.
A cleared watercourse turns giving into the channel that directs replenishment.
Increase and flourishing supply the channel's visible yield.
Earth revived by rain extends the human life-preservation claim into an ecological image.
A visible watering access makes the assigned path a point where life-bearing provision is reached.
Water issuing from an opening supplies the release point that reverses feared constriction.

changed_reading.before: Support and zakat are social and fiscal categories.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, wilaya is an irrigation circuit: replenishment follows, giving clears a channel, and purified transfer produces shared life and growth.

strongest_changes: The Cain sequence turns focus giving into a lifeward redirection of the hand and a test of nonpredatory support.
Distortion, guarding, witnessing, and oversight sharpen the focus triad into a custody chain for transmitted trust.
The polarity of gentleness and strength in 5:54 disambiguates bowing as disciplined humility rather than general weakness.
The 5:51-56 frame makes wilaya identity-forming and noncontingent rather than a hedge against changing fortunes.
The intake and sale economy of 5:42-44 makes outward, purifying transfer a material audit of allegiance.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly converted a nominal affiliation claim into directional tests: where the hand moves, whether a trust stays in place, which way wealth flows, when the body lowers, and whether commitment survives a feared reversal.
remaining_uncertainties: The hand-to-zakat link is a contextual contrast, not an explicit mention of the hand in 5:55.
The plural-path reading may describe the wider test without redefining the bounded believing group in the focus verse.
The relay and irrigation models depend on deliberately branch-distant material images and should remain exploratory overlays.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Allegiance is identified by sustaining and yielding practices.** `و ل ي B004` is loyal support, `ق و م B009` support/mainstay, `ز ك و B001` growth, and `ر ك ع B001` bodily lowering. I infer that true patronage is not a label but a cycle: upright maintenance funds communal growth while remaining humbly lowered.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later ayah 5:120 made the fixed ayah's local distinctions newly visible as bounded operations within a single encompassing dominion, rather than as an isolated rule or episode.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Protective alignment is recognized through embodied worship and transfer.** Fixed **و ل ي / B003** (“assuming charge and authority”) and **B004** (“loyal alliance and support”) define the relation, while fixed **ر ك ع / B003** (“humility and abasement”) gives its bodily posture. The ayah joins established prayer, outgoing alms, and bowing; 5:56 turns the aligned participants into a prevailing party. I infer that this authority is socially legible because vertical submission produces horizontal provision. *Walī* therefore reads as a charged support relation enacted in worship and redistribution, not a merely declared affinity.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 5:56 showed the practices of 5:55 consolidating into a faction, confirming that worship and transfer are not private signs but group-forming acts.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, ortak çekirdeği bir varlığı harekete geçirip göndermek ya da elde tutmayı bırakıp salmak olarak kurar. İnsan, elçi, rüzgar, yağmur ve başka güçler bu işlemin farklı nesneleridir; bunlar ayrı birer çekirdek anlam değildir.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanı, canlıyı, doğal gücü ya da başka bir şeyi bulunduğu yerden harekete geçirip bir yöne göndermek; kimi bağlamlarda elde tutmayı bırakıp serbestçe gitmesine izin vermektir.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, bir varlığı durduğu veya tutulduğu konumdan çıkarıp ileri yöneltmektir.
Bir kişi görev veya haber için, rüzgar ve yağmur gibi güçler de etkilerini göstermek üzere gönderilebilir.
Tutmanın karşıtı olarak kullanım, eldeki canlıyı ya da denetlenen gücü salıvermeyi anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali acikca tasdik, haber ya da vaadi dogru sayma ve bazi dini kullanislarda hakka boyun egme olarak verir. Provisional cerceve guvene dokunan yanini not eder, fakat dal kimligi korkusuzluk degil tasdik ve kabul iliskisidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hem genel tasdik adlari hem de belirli soz obekleri ve dini kullanislar vardir; tanim bunlari yalin guven anlamina genisletmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru sayip ona icten kabul ile yonelmektir. Dini kullanista bu kabul, kalp, dil ve davranisla baglanan bir boyun egme ya da seriate girme anlami kazanabilir.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek bir haberin, sozun veya hakikatin dogru sayilmasidir.
Hakka yonelik ic kabul, yalniz bilmekten ziyade boyun egme ve kabullenme bicimi alir.
Dini alanlarda bu kabul, bildirilen yola girme ve ona baglanma adi olarak kullanilir.
Ilahi sifat kullaniminda vaat edilen odulu dogrulama veya guvenceyle bildirme boyutu one cikar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi temizlik, düzgünlük ve sakınmayı aynı ahlaki çekirdekte birleştirir; birini düzeltip arındırma, iç temizliği ve dinen uygun olup kötü sonuç doğurmayan yiyecek bu çekirdeğin bağlama bağlı açılımlarıdır. Mali payın temizleyici sayılması burada yalnız anlam ilişkisini açıklar; mali uygulamanın kendisi ayrı dalda tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın temizlik ve düzgünlük anlamı; kişiyi düzeltme, iç dünya, kendini övme ve yiyeceğin uygunluğu gibi yapıya bağlı kullanımlarla karıştırılmadan sunulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin veya iç durumun kusurdan arınıp ahlaken temiz, doğru ve sakınan bir niteliğe kavuşması ya da bir başkasının onu bu duruma getirmesidir. Yiyecek bağlamında dinen izin verilen ve sonu zarar getirmeyen olmayı da anlatabilir.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, ahlaki veya manevi bakımdan temiz ve düzgün durumda olmaktır.
Bir kişinin bu niteliği taşıması, doğru davranan ve kötülükten sakınan biri olmasıyla belirginleşir.
Anlam, bir kişiyi veya iç dünyayı arındırıp düzeltme ve iyiliklerle geliştirme eylemine uzanır.
Yiyecek için kullanıldığında dinen izin verilen, iyi ve sonradan zarar doğurmayan seçeneği belirtir.
Maldan verilen zorunlu payın temizleyici sayılması, bu ahlaki temizlik alanıyla kurulan açıklayıcı bir bağlantıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım temizlik ve düzgünlüğü, kişinin sakınan niteliğini, birini düzeltip arındırmayı ve iç temizliğini birleştirir; yiyeceğin dinen uygun ve sonucu iyi olması da bağlama bağlı bir açılımdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kişinin veya iç durumun kusurdan uzaklaşıp temiz, doğru ve sakınan bir niteliğe kavuşmasını anlatan temel karşılıktır.

word_analysis_qac_alignment.note: aligned_qac_word_ref does NOT resolve against qac_morphemes for this ayah: word-analysis counts orthographic words where QAC counts morphological words. Upstream defect in quran-data's word-analysis; deliberately not auto-repaired (renumbering would fabricate identities).

channel_generated_outputs.note: Generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path outputs are available as external quran-data files; read them only when channel detail is necessary, and do not treat them as an adjudicated channel ledger.

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. branch_policy.compact_gloss_policy: Reviewed gloss branches remain as branch_ref/payload_tier stubs; their branch records are trimmed, not filtered out.
branch_policy.note: Every root target and dictionary branch identity is retained. Branch payload detail is tiered from generation-time citations; non-full branches and reviewed gloss records are trimmed, not absent. Root lexicon and branch inventory availability never create interest.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.
